task_completion.description: Create an enclosed back-of-house utility room with at least two partition walls and one door.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for a small enclosed area within the floor plan containing at least two newly drawn wall segments and a door icon/swing.

task_completion.description: Define and name at least four functional zones (e.g., 'Wash Floor', 'Lounge', 'Utility', 'Folding').
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check the 2D floor plan for text labels or room area designations identifying four distinct functional areas.

task_completion.description: Place a high-density equipment bank of at least 20 large appliances (washers/dryers).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count the appliance icons (washers/dryers) in the layout; there must be at least 20 arranged in banks or rows.

task_completion.description: Incorporate a customer area with at least four tables and eight seating items.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify and count furniture icons; verify at least 4 table objects and 8 chair/bench objects are present.

task_completion.description: Add at least two dimension lines annotating aisle clearances for ADA accessibility.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for at least two dimension strings (lines with arrows and numerical measurements) placed in walking aisles.
Look for the 'Save As' dialog box with the correct file path or the file name 'laundromat.sh3d' in the application title bar.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to design the layout rather than just manipulating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the 2D/3D viewports, furniture catalog, and wall drawing tools.

integrity.description: The layout is a custom creation and not a pre-existing template.
integrity.visual_evidence: The progression of screenshots should show walls being drawn and furniture being placed individually or in groups over time.

integrity.description: The agent did not use scripts to generate the .sh3d XML content directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal should not show complex sed/awk commands or python scripts used to inject objects into the save file.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must use Sweet Home 3D. The starter file 'laundromat_starter.sh3d' is a stripped shell. The final score is based on the presence of 20+ appliances, 4+ tables, 8+ seats, 2+ dimension lines, 4+ named zones, and a utility room with 2+ walls and a door. The file must be saved specifically to /home/ga/Documents/laundromat.sh3d.
